title: On the Dual-Use Dilemma in Physical Reasoning and Force
reasoning: The paper evaluates vision-language models on the 'dual-use dilemma,' specifically testing their ability to navigate the ethical boundary between helpful actions (like surgical incisions) and harmful ones (like stabbing). It utilizes Isaac Asimov's First Law of Robotics as an ethical safeguard and studies how such moral/ethical constraints impact both safety and utility.
